extDescription: YouTube Full Title For Videos: Shows full video titles on YouTube instead of cutting them off.
welcomeTitle: YouTube Full Title For Videos is installed
welcomeLead: YouTube Full Title For Videos now shows video titles on YouTube in full instead of cutting them off after two lines.
sampleTitle: How I Built a Tiny Cabin in the Woods With Hand Tools Only, Start to Finish in 30 Days (Full Build, No Talking)
tipRefresh: Refresh any YouTube tabs that were already open.
tipWhere: Works on the home page, search results, channel pages, playlists and the suggestions next to a video.
tipPrivacy: Nothing to set up and no account needed.
heroLead: See every YouTube video title in full. No more titles cut off after two lines, and no more hovering to read the rest.
f1d: Long titles are shown in full instead of ending in “…”. You never have to hover to read the rest.
f3d: Install it and you are done. No settings, no account, no buttons to press.
f4d: It only changes how titles are displayed, and it runs only on youtube.com.
s1d: Install YouTube Full Title For Videos from the Chrome Web Store.
s3d: Every video title now appears in full, on every page.
a1: Yes. YouTube Full Title For Videos is free to use.
a2: No. It adds a single small style rule to the page and does nothing else.
q3: Which browsers does it work in?
a3: It is built for Chrome. Browsers that install extensions from the Chrome Web Store, such as Edge, Brave and Opera, usually run it too.
q4: A title is still cut off. What should I do?
a4: Refresh the page first. If it is still cut off, YouTube has probably changed its layout. Please report it on the support page.
a5: None. The extension does not collect, store or send any personal data.
footDisclaimer: YouTube Full Title For Videos is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by YouTube or Google LLC.
